source.title: Towards an Algebraic Proof of Deligne's Regularity Criterion. An Informal Survey of Open Problems

trace.notes: Normalized the single URL input as a zbMATH resolver record with document identifier 5121553. Local resolver metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv and outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv identifies the exact work as Francesco Baldassarri, 'Towards an Algebraic Proof of Deligne's Regularity Criterion. An Informal Survey of Open Problems,' Milan Journal of Mathematics 73, pages 237-258, 2005, DOI 10.1007/s00032-005-0046-9. The exact zbMATH page was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge in local curl and later local DNS resolution for zbmath.org/api.zbmath.org was unavailable.

Identifier-specific recovery followed the DOI to the Springer landing page and direct Springer PDF pattern. The article page exposed only title, abstract, bibliographic metadata, and access purchase/login prompts; the PDF endpoint redirected to the same metadata/paywall page, so it was classified as paywalled_or_restricted and metadata_only rather than readable full text.

Bounded exact-work recovery inspected the University of Padua repository record and exact-title/DOI search candidates. The Padua record explicitly reported no associated files. Other candidates were citation metadata, bibliographies, or a different work ('An algebraic proof of Deligne's regularity criterion') and were rejected because they did not provide a readable artifact for the exact zbMATH/DOI source.
